anchor_sources: Mayor et al., Nat. Commun. 16, 2576 (2025) [omega_m, kappa, gamma_m, g0]
Mathew, del Pino, Verhagen, Nat. Nanotechnol. 15, 198-202 (2020) [J_m scale]
interpretation: The strong-coupling hyperchaos regime requires optomechanical coupling and mechanical damping that are 2-3 orders of magnitude above the anchored Mayor/Mathew values (limiting coordinate: g1, 2542x). The inter-resonator hopping is within the scanned Mathew range. The regime is therefore a model-level demonstration, not a prediction for the anchored device; the drive amplitude is not convertible to input power without the pump frequency and external coupling.
